scripts.f:prep: pnpm --filter frontend generate:abis && pnpm --filter frontend pull:addresses
scripts.f:run: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter frontend preview
scripts.b:warptoad:compile: cd backend/contracts/aztec/WarpToadCore && aztec compile && aztec codegen -o src/artifacts target
scripts.b:rootbridge:compile: cd backend/contracts/aztec/L2AztecBridgeAdapter && aztec compile && aztec codegen -o src/artifacts target
scripts.b:contract:gen: cd backend/circuits/withdraw && nargo compile && bb write_vk -b ./target/withdraw.json && bb contract
scripts.b:contract:rename: pnpm --filter @warp-toad/backend ts-node ./scripts/dev_op/replaceLine.ts --file ./contracts/evm/WithdrawVerifier.sol --remove 'contract UltraVerifier is BaseUltraVerifier {' --replace 'contract WithdrawVerifier is BaseUltraVerifier {'
scripts.b:circuit: pnpm b:contract:gen && pnpm b:contract:move && pnpm b:contract:rename
